artifact_discovery.initial_probe_note: The two required spaced checks used the guessed names F1-c1.patch and F2-c1.patch rather than the actual F1-masked-fixtures.patch and F2-masked-fixtures.patch. All actual patches were then applied and tested; the earlier missing-name probe is not treated as proof that the actual F1 file was absent.

spaced_wrong_name_probe.command: sleep 60; date -Ins; for f in .ufo/waves/round-87/patches/F1-c1.patch .ufo/waves/round-87/patches/F2-c1.patch .ufo/waves/round-87/patches/X1-c1.patch; do if test -f "$f"; then printf 'PRESENT %s\n' "$f"; else printf 'MISSING %s\n' "$f"; fi; done
